plugins.name: market-analysis
plugins.description: The market-analysis role on contract v3 (issue-160 round-3 promotion). Decides: 경쟁 구도에서 이 스펙이 서는가.

plugins.name: mece-proposal
plugins.description: MECE, recommendation-first phase-1 proposal structure gate (5 required elements: decision framed, frameworks selected+why, evidence plan, adoption rationale, plugin-reflection plan). Phase-1 only; no ordering dependency on the other market-analysis plugins.

plugins.name: evidence-rigor
plugins.description: Evidence-traceability gate: every methodological/factual claim carries a source or a labeled assumption. The one plugin shared across both phase-1 (proposals) and phase-2 (record) write surfaces. No ordering dependency on the other market-analysis plugins.

plugins.name: five-forces
plugins.description: Porter's Five Forces phase-2 record gate: all 5 distinct forces (supplier and buyer bargaining power kept separate), each evidence-cited. No ordering dependency on the other market-analysis plugins.

plugins.name: competitor-mapping
plugins.description: Direct + indirect competitor evidence-linked inventory phase-2 record gate. No ordering dependency on the other market-analysis plugins.

plugins.name: jtbd-fit
plugins.description: Jobs-to-be-done customer-need-fit verdict phase-2 record gate: named customer job + differentiation verdict vs. the strongest competing alternative. No ordering dependency on the other market-analysis plugins.
